items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: So I played an arrangement, GRACIRA sings 'Mango Mangue'

ctx.x: said, you know, I'm -- he said, this number (inaudible) this number is (inaudible), and I don't want to touch nothing that'll conflict. You got anything else? Yeah. I tell you, I got -- I say, I've got a whole lot of numbers, but they -- you know, in Cuban music everything is vocal (inaudible). He said, I don't care. When the vocal is supposed to sing, you just cue me, and I'm coming in.
So I played an arrangement, GRACIRA sings 'Mango Mangue' (inaudible) bongo-bongo.
